What changed in version %1$s
Version %1$s. %2$s Tap to see what’s new.
Search from the playback controls, sharper lock-screen artwork and Settings that show how things stand.
Search without leaving the remote
From the playback controls, search inside the app on screen or across the whole TV. YouTube has its own search shortcut too.
Artwork on the lock screen
The lock-screen card leads with the artwork of what’s playing, sharp rather than a blurred app icon.
Settings at a glance
Settings opens on four tiles: TV, soundbar, sync and features. Anything that needs you comes first, with the one button that sorts it.
Edit the dock with a long press
Press and hold an empty spot in the dock to rearrange it.
More app icons
Many UK and European TV apps now wear their own icons, from BBC iPlayer to ZDF, DAZN and Rakuten TV.
Stable or test builds
In About, choose whether to get test builds. With them off, tutti stays on final releases.
The TV’s link, as it is

The remote says connected only when it is, and shows a drop straight away. Coming back to tutti, the link is kept for a few minutes, and a reconnect is one quiet fade, with what’s on the TV left in place.
One way to say how things stand
Connections, Settings and setup use the same words and signs for each device’s state.
Back to the remote after an update
An update closes tutti. A quiet notification now brings you straight back.
Nuvio’s fast forward on the jog wheel
Over Nuvio, the jog wheel jumps by the app’s own step.
Keys no longer vanish after the phone sleeps
A TV connection that went quiet while the phone slept is reopened before your first press goes into it.
Playback controls no longer crash over Nuvio
Opening them over Nuvio could close tutti. Not any more.
The TV’s own apps, by name
The now-showing card names the TV’s built-in apps too, not only the ones tutti already knows.
Say again? and an end-of-episode switch-off in Playback, a pause for phone calls, and Settings with a page for each topic.
Say again?
In Playback, Say again? goes back a few seconds and turns on captions and the bar’s voice enhancement until the line has played again, then puts both back.
Switch off at the end of the episode
From Power or Playback, the TV and the soundbar switch off when what you cast ends, fading the sound over its last two minutes. A switch-off can also wait for a time of day.
A pause for phone calls
In Settings › Automatic, the TV can pause when the phone rings or a call starts, and play again once the call ends.
Quieter evenings
Between two times you choose, the soundbar switches to Night and Voice and keeps a lower volume guard, then everything goes back.
Picture mode by app
The TV’s picture mode can change with the app or input on screen.
Share what’s on
Share the title playing, with its cover art. Optional buttons open it on Trakt, JustWatch or IMDb.
Title details
If you turn it on, Playback shows the synopsis, cast and rating of what’s playing, from Cinemeta.
Open an app where you want
A dock pin can open its app at a page or link you choose, rather than where it was last time.
Back up your settings
Save your settings to a file and bring them back. Devices, addresses and keys are never in it.
A page for each topic
Settings has one page per topic, Automatic and Say again? included, and keeps your place when you come back.
Third-party services in one place
Everything that reaches a service beyond your TV and soundbar sits on one page. New ones start off, and Only free services turns them all off.
Artwork first
The compact card leads with the artwork of what’s playing, and posters are shown whole.
Know what a long press does
Holding a dock pin names its action in a bubble before it fires.
A new TV identity in one tap
When the TV shows a second identity, you trust it in one tap instead of pairing again.
Holding an arrow
Holding a d-pad arrow now holds it on the TV, without a backlog of repeats.
Typing on the TV
Text sent to the TV arrives on time and in order, with the cursor after the last character.
Steady over Wi-Fi
When Wi-Fi falters for a moment, tutti stays on it rather than trying the TV over mobile data and dropping the link.
An icon for every input
The inputs sheet shows each input with its icon.
